title: Version-separated GA and private preview
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Route GA/preview to separate AKS versions; identify a selector that accidentally mixes audiences.

sourceContract.readme: | S128 | **AKS, blue-green/canary:** Use capable ingress, gateway, or service-mesh routing; Deployment objects alone do not supply weighted user routing. |
sourceContract.backlog: | D-S128 | P1 | Add AKS version-specific backend routing and ring/canary promotion. | Separate Deployments/Services and gateway routes preserve cohorts; no accidental selector mixes GA and preview; user outcomes are verified. | P003, D-S008 |
sourceContract.acceptance: Separate Deployments/Services and gateway routes preserve cohorts; no accidental selector mixes GA and preview; user outcomes are verified.
sourceContract.portableCard: | A-S128 | D-S128 | S | Route GA/preview to separate AKS versions; identify a selector that accidentally mixes audiences. | SOURCE |
sourceContract.nativeSibling: | B-S128 | D-S128 | S | Conduct one AKS cohort preset; verify version-specific services, gateway routing, and user evidence. | CORE, DATA, AKS, C074 |
sourceContract.originalDependencies: P003, D-S008 plus BASE (H011, P005, applicable HOST)

documentedConstraints.constraint: Service selectors usually identify pod endpoint sets; they do not establish API compatibility or preview authorization.
Service selectors are equality maps with AND requirements; an app-only selector can match both software builds.
A capable qualified Gateway can weight separate Service backends; Deployment objects alone do not supply weighted user routing. No documented example manifests or resources are generated.
Workload readiness, overlap capacity and lifecycle reliability require independent evidence; fictional selection does not measure these native settings.

preconditions: Every selector, Deployment, Service, pod, software/API version, GA/preview membership, authorization, routing, request and state field is fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.
Four fictional pod records in two version-specific Deployment records are assumed ready; no capacity or resource changes occur.
GA expects build-1 and authorized private preview expects build-2; both normally preserve profile-v1.
Two complete login/callback/navigation/profile/cart journeys preserve fictional identity, session, payload, cart:3, one effect and each original 400 ms budget.
All four declared private paths require both unauthorized GA denial and authorized preview allowance observations.
actions: Choose allowlisted fictional selector, routing and observation-fixture tokens.
Inspect selected Service endpoint sets and routing-capability DATA.
Observe desired versus actual fictional cohort destinations independently.
Verify complete journeys and every declared private-preview access path independently.
Inspect positive, negative and unknown results and all retained history.
Explicitly reset this page's bounded in-memory rehearsal.
assertions: Separate Service selector endpoint sets match the correct software builds; app-only, wrong-build, empty or invalid selectors cannot pass.
Separate Deployment records alone cannot prove weighted user routing.
Desired selection and HTTP 200 do not establish actual destination, authorization or complete-journey correctness.
Zero GA traffic selection to build-2 does not permit a leaked private preview callback.
Correct software build does not guarantee profile-v1 API compatibility or preserved state/budgets.
Missing destinations, completion or authorization remain unknown; both attempted journeys stay counted.
Typed descriptor-based input guards and deterministic state/history replay reject coercion, getters and forgery without mutation.
Valid premature actions retain failed holds; twelve actions are retained without pruning until explicit reset.
Actual DOM, keyboard, alert, reset, missing-model failure and CSP denial are observed using the published isolated helper.

verification.normalVerification: READ-ONLY: every owned source and existing proof file is hashed before and after; no rewriting.
verification.deliberateCapture: Only exact CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 adds unique wx raw browser/verification files, never overwriting previous observations.
verification.helper: testing\browser\isolated.cjs, openIsolatedLesson with awaited close() in finally
verification.tooling: Existing Node 22.23.4 / offline Playwright 1.56.1 / Microsoft-signed installed Edge 156.0.4314.50; test tooling only.
verification.sourceByteIntegrity: Working CRLF/raw byte archives and canonical Git blob identities are separately sealed.
verification.iac: N/A: resource-free fixed fictional DATA; no infrastructure code or configuration generated.

limits: No actual AKS, network, identity, credentials, resource, configuration, deployment, gateway, authorization, request, storage or IaC operation.
No cloud, scaffold, packages, framework, downloads, unsafe flags, foreground leases or spend.
No actual weighted-distribution, native readiness/routing, source-parent completion, production Node 24 or five-nines proof.
Published browser helper retains known unattended page/context/cleanup lifecycle limitations; inactive recovery prototype is unqualified and unused.

B-S128 and D-S128 retain CORE/DATA/AKS/C074, approved native target/live authorization, real version-specific endpoints, capable routing, all-path access, compatible complete journeys and ordered ring/canary promotion requirements.
One original frozen A-S128 S unit only after parent acceptance; zero extra test/repair/proof/refinement credits.
C005-C008/local-harness integration, root/shared documentation and ledger edits remain parent-owned.
